title: The Dog Night, 2001
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Two years. Wordless. The neon has lost nothing yet.

panels.composition: The dumpster. Night. The bulb. WOOD and BARNABY. Same framing as last year.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog standing behind a bowling alley at night before a rusted dumpster under a bare bulb, same composition as the year before, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The dog sitting. Two years older. Slightly thicker in the neck.

image.prompt: close-up of a scruffy dog sitting under a bare bulb, no words

panels.composition: Wood crouching to the dog's height, looking at what the dog looks at: the dumpster, from below.

image.prompt: a young man crouched to a dog's eye height beside the dog, both looking at a rusted dumpster from below, no words

panels.composition: Walking away. The sign. All lit.

image.prompt: a young man and a dog walking away under a fully lit bowling-alley neon sign at night, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)
